title: Wikidata grounding pilot: the 43 people with their own atlas entry
method: Each person was searched with the WikidataMCP semantic search (search_items), never the REST name search. One candidate was accepted only when its label, nationality and occupation matched the atlas entry; near-namesakes are listed in notes. Birth and death dates were then fetched for all accepted QIDs in one SPARQL query over P569/P570, and statement-level values were inspected where the query result looked wrong (Rodney) or imprecise (Pinchbeck). Wikidata content is CC0.

status_values.conflict: candidates disagree; needs a human decision

not_covered: The 786 people who appear only in rosters and strands are not in this pilot.
